changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwfinancialdocumentnumbering AS SELECT fdn.id, fdn.facility_id, fdn.document_type, fdn.prefix, fdn.sequence_length, fdn.include_year, fdn.include_facility_code, fdn.number_separator, fdn.reset_frequency, fdn.starting_number, fdn.active, fdn.status, fdn.created_by, fdn.created_date, fdn.last_modified_by, fdn.last_modified_date, fdn.last_number, fdn.current_period_key, fdn.version FROM public.financial_document_numbering fdn;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwfinancialdocumentnumbering TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwfinancialdocumentnumbering FROM report_user;
